title: Libya Conflict Tracker Update — Tue Aug 25, 2026
summary: Five days after the '4+4' committee initialled a draft election-law and elections-commission deal in Tunis, cracks opened over its legitimacy. Protesters blocked roads and burned tyres in several areas of Tripoli on August 25, reviving the civil disobedience campaign against prolonged electricity outages that began in late July.

summary: SOS Méditerranée Warns of Escalating Harassment of Migrant Boats and Rescue Ships Off Libya.

title: Libya Conflict Tracker Update — Tue Aug 18, 2026
summary: The Tripoli branch of the Libyan Red Crescent recovered nine bodies over two days from a wooden boat carrying an estimated 19 people that capsized off Tajoura, roughly 22km east of Tripoli.
